title: New Meta Ads Update Monthly Invoicing
description: New Meta Ads Update Monthly Invoicing
transcript: Have you heard of this new META update? META just made a move that most advertisers are completely missing. They're quietly killing credit card payments specifically for high spend ad accounts. Starting April 1st, you either have to switch to a bank, debit or monthly invoicing or your ad stop. No more points. Why? Because META doesn't want to pay 2 to 3% in credit card fees anymore. This is a margin play by meta. But it is bigger than that. They're tightening control over cash flow, account verification, and who actually gets to scale. Smaller advertisers. They're on touch for now, but big spenders. You're now playing on meta terms, and here's where it gets real. Now you're running payroll, placing inventory orders, and paying a massive meta invoice at the end of the month all at the same time with no buffer, delay or leverage. This isn't a billing update. This is a cash flow stress test. The platforms are getting stricter and the game is getting tighter. So the real question is, can your business actually sustain the cash flow?
